caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sled with curved runners on both ends, rendered in a top-down view. The sled is primarily painted in a greenish-blue color, with reddish-brown accents along the edges and joint areas. The surface of the sled shows signs of wear and aging, with faded paint and visible wood grain. Decorative lines and motifs in red are painted on the front and sides, and there is a partially legible white script on the main body of the sled, along with a small painted figure or crest near the center left. Metal loops are attached near the ends of the runners, and a brown strap or rope is placed across the top. The sled sits on a plain, light-colored background. The artist's name, "WAYNE WHITE," is printed in small text in the lower right corner.
title: Sled
